title: Faction Dancer 2 Skis (Blue) w/ Strive 11 GW Binding 2026 - 182cm
description:
Faction Skis designed their Dancer 2 Skis (Blue) w/ Strive 11 GW Binding 2026 - 182cm to stand up to demanding days in the mountains. The Dancer 2 Ski with Strive 11 GW offers pure all-mountain freeride bliss-it's the ideal blend of up-tempo energy, light weight and stable, full-confidence handling. Its 96 mm waist is versatile to handle all conditions and all terrain. You'll even float and dance above the choppy stuff thanks to the perfect touch of rocker. It's the magic of the Dancer 2, only sans titanal, for a more approachable ride. Featuring a rental-ready topsheet and metal tip protectors, this ski is backed by the finest, most durable Austrian construction-powered 100% by renewable energy. Built with recycled materials, never sacrificing durability. Faction is working with their production partners to eliminate material waste. They now mix base, sidewall and topsheet material scraps back into the raw material used for production, reducing carbon emissions while ensuring the same level of quality & durability.; Locally Sourced Materials: In an effort to reduce the impact of our supply chain, we strive to source materials from European companies that are based near our factories.; 100% Renewable Energy Factory: This ski is produced in a cutting-edge facility that runs on electrical power that is 100% renewable. Additionally, its heating energy comes solely from biomass. The factory no longer uses oil, resulting in annual CO2 emission reductions in the millions of kilograms.; XL 2.5mm Edges, compared to 2 mm industry average, built to last; Full Strength Sidewall, for the best-possible edge hold and protection of the wood core, made from recycled material. A construction that places strips of protective material along the sides of each core, between the edge and the topsheet. Sidewalls provide the best possible edge hold and stability when the ski is engaged in a turn as well as protecting the woodcore, edges and topsheet from impact and outside damage. ; Anti-Chip Micro Cap protects the tips and tails from wear and tear, their construction keeps durability and reliable performance front and center.

PRODUCT CONDITION

These skis Faction Dancer 2 Skis (Blue) w/ Strive 11 GW Binding 2026 - 182cm are in New condition.

Products in New condition have not been used or worn, and show no signs of wear. New items may have the original tags attached or come in their original packaging.

TECH SPECS

  • Tip/Waist/Tail: 127/96/117
  • Turning Radius: 19m
  • Camber: 4
  • Tip and tail rocker + traditional camber, for the perfect blend of high performance edge hold, easy turn initiation, and float in soft snow.
  • Tip Rocker Length: 300
  • Tail Rocker Length: 180
  • Core: Poplar is a light-colored, medium-weight, durable softwood that flexes and pops nicely as well as having a whole load of vibration absorption capabilities. Used as the only wood in this core, it allows the ski to pop, butter and stomp like an all-mountain freestyle ski and also have enough torsional stability to grip impressively on the downhill.
  • Elliptical Sidecut, longer radius underfoot for long, stable arcs and shorter radius in the tip and tail for awesome versatility, effortless turn initiation. Elliptical Sidecut is made up of a longer radius underfoot and shorter radii in the tip and tail of the ski. The long radius underfoot means you can pivot faster and easier, while a shorter radius in the tip and tail result in easier turn initiation. This sidecut allows for a wide variety of turn lengths, angles and mounting positions
  • Mustache Flex: The "Mustache Flex" offers stability underfoot for solid edge hold, with a smooth, progressive flex in the tips and tails to easily absorb all the different bumps and snow debris the mountain throws at you
  • Freeride flat tail
  • Scratch resistant topsheet
  • Terrain: All-Mountain Frontside Flow
  • These skis come premounted with system binding plates and include the Strive 11 GW Binding.
